name: HelloCircuitState
description: Demo state for the hello-circuit page, seeded from the URL hash (e.g. #closed, #closed&v=24, #short). Nothing is persisted; production starts with the switch open at the bulb's rated voltage.

name: Circuit3DState
description: Demo state for the 3D circuit page, seeded from the URL hash (e.g. #closed&v=24&t=2.5&cam=60,25,9). A fixed t freezes animation time so captures are pixel-stable; cam sets orbit yaw,pitch,distance. Nothing is persisted; production starts with the switch open at the bulb's rated voltage and a live clock.

name: StatusReport
description: Generated engine status report (site/status/report.json) written by `cargo run -p xtask -- site-report`: build identity, test totals, per-crate dependency counts, capabilities joined to their demos and proving tests. The status page fetches it; scenarios seed alternate states by pointing the page at a fixture report via `?report=fixtures/<name>.json`, and the crate filter via `#crate=<name>`. Nothing is persisted.

name: PuzzleProgress
description: Progress for the 3D circuit puzzle game, stored in localStorage. Tracks which levels have been solved.

name: CircuitPuzzleLevel
description: Data-driven level for the 3D circuit puzzle game. Seeded from JSON/TOML files or URL hashes.
